ST-E2E-NATIVE.scope: Compiled standalone UI against the real native PTY daemon: capabilities, creation, live input, snapshot, select mode, detach persistence, exact links, splits, fullscreen, responsive layouts, attachments, and exact confirmed termination.

ST-CORE-LAYOUT.scope: Recursive splits, placement, tab reorder/move/close, duplicate prevention, stable identities, resize persistence, malformed-state rejection, and v1 migration.

ST-CORE-RECONNECT.scope: Five-second handshake policy, bounded 1/2/4/8-second retry budget, opened-socket handling, and truthful status copy.

ST-CORE-SELECT.scope: Bounded file-token extraction/batching, exact snapshot reconstruction, confirmed-link segmentation, URL allowlist, punctuation, and unsafe-scheme rejection.

ST-CORE-ATTACHMENTS.scope: File-drag detection, count/size/name validation, exact target generation guards, agent-neutral paste copy, and never-submit semantics.

ST-CORE-DICTATION.scope: Terminal-control removal, newline/tab flattening, safe insertion spacing, and transcript formatting without Enter.

ST-REACT-AUTOMATION.scope: Optional provider UI distinguishes Learn/Active, bounded countdown/cancel states, agent readiness, and project-memory failures.

ST-REACT-DICTATION.scope: Optional transcription-provider request and explicit unavailable/error behavior.

ST-GATEWAY.scope: Exact workspace/session routing, capability truth, origin and mutation boundaries, explicit workspace configuration, and optional-feature defaults.

ST-NATIVE-LIFECYCLE.scope: Native CRUD and conflicts, exact workspace identity, private socket modes, live PTY I/O, multi-attach replay, detach survival, gateway recreation, and fail-closed daemon stop.

ST-TMUX-COMPAT.scope: Optional tmux adapter health, missing-server behavior, exact lifecycle/rename/agent observation, literal input, and provider-neutral error mapping.

ST-PATH-SECURITY.scope: Allowed-root resolution plus independent no-follow download revalidation and symlink/escape refusal.

ST-ATTACHMENT-SERVICE.scope: Private streaming, inclusive limits, quotas, cancellation/overflow cleanup, expiry, unknown-file preservation, and image sanitation.

ST-PTY.scope: Output coalescing and PTY cleanup plus regression coverage for input delivered during attachment startup.

ST-SOAK.scope: Eight gateway recreations and eight WebSocket attachments retain one native daemon PID, exact session identity, and all eight terminal markers.

ST-SECURITY.scope: Dependency vulnerability, Python static analysis, secret, and personal-path review for the release tree.

ST-PACKAGE.scope: npm/Python artifact contents, clean wheel and npm tarball installs, embedded UI/native daemon, neutral release content, tmux-free default, and runnable container doctor.

ST-HOST-BOUNDARY.scope: Typed provider boundary keeps routing, command palette, task dispatch, dictation, and automation owned by the consuming host.

DF-SPLIT.scope: Packaged component dock, tabs, drag/keyboard placement, recursive splits, persistence/migration, exact links, fullscreen exclusivity, mobile, and automation behavior in Dolphin.

DF-RECONNECT.scope: Visible stalled-handshake retries and actionable bounded offline state in the Dolphin host.

DF-PATHS.scope: Confirmed files only, retry, safe external links/context menu, exact selectable text, and no activation during drag selection.

DF-DICTATION.scope: Exact xterm insertion without Enter plus active/idle responsive dictation layout.

DF-RENAME.scope: Long/shared-prefix names, exact inline rename, managed-session protection, mobile controls, and terminal-focused command palette.

DF-DENSITY.scope: Sole top inventory, 80-column/40-row desktop terminal floor, and cockpit density persistence.

DF-ATTACHMENTS.scope: Exact Codex/Claude/plain-shell attachment targets, no automatic submission, and compact terminal toolbar sizing.

DF-DISPATCH.command: npm run test:e2e -- control-center.spec.ts && python -m pytest -q
DF-DISPATCH.scope: Todo work is sent only to the selected exact eligible agent target and failure remains recoverable.

DF-ROUTING.command: npm test && npm run test:e2e -- terminal-split-workspace.spec.ts
DF-ROUTING.scope: Exact session deep links activate or open once while host route construction remains outside the component.

DF-UNIT.scope: Full Dolphin frontend unit suite with packaged component boundary, shared automation copy, style ordering, focus, motion, and typography contracts.

DF-BACKEND.command: python -m compileall -q app && python -m pytest -q tests/test_tmux_service.py tests/test_tmux_session_rename.py tests/test_terminal_attachment_service.py tests/test_terminal_path_service.py tests/test_image_attachment_service.py tests/test_dictation_service.py tests/test_session_automation.py tests/test_codex_todo_service.py
DF-BACKEND.scope: The 140-test focused Dolphin backend gate retains canonical tmux, attachments, dictation, automation, and todo policy.

DF-BOUNDARY.command: npm run check:terminal-boundary && npm run build
DF-BOUNDARY.scope: Dolphin imports only the standalone package UI/core while retaining a thin product adapter; deleted duplicate implementations cannot return unnoticed.

DF-ROLLBACK.command: VITE_DOLPHIN_TERMINAL_SOURCE=legacy npm run build; packaged build and the same 36 terminal browser cases
DF-ROLLBACK.scope: The legacy implementation was built and exercised before removal; the immutable 7f8161c source commit remains the tested Git rollback point.

VIS-DESKTOP.scope: 1440x900 dock, tab, toolbar, live native terminal, theme, status, and current icons.

VIS-SELECT.scope: Selectable terminal-history surface and toolbar toggle.

VIS-SPLIT.scope: Two live exact sessions, divider, independent toolbars, and horizontally constrained tabs.

VIS-ATTACHMENT.scope: File-drag attachment overlay over an exact terminal pane.

VIS-FULLSCREEN.scope: Exclusive fullscreen terminal and reachable active toolbar with background panes/dividers hidden.

VIS-MOBILE.scope: 390x844 mobile switcher, one mounted live pane, 44px actions, and zero body overflow.
